topic: DMA-buf accounting after nonfatal record allocation failure
status: resolved source adaptation; real OOM and concurrent runtime behavior not verified
evidence: a7db20b7e4ce counts duplicate references without allocating and marks a context incomplete when a new record cannot be obtained. It continues counting/draining existing records, never creates new records in that context, and returns EIO from RSS/PSS/HWM reads/reset. This prevents later untracked closes decrementing a new record and keeps nonfatal fd/mmap contracts. Local lmkd handles read failure by excluding the DMA-buf term; its OOM victim sizing can be less informed. PSS for other contexts remains an estimate over tracked users. Full candidate and source evidence: evidence/dmabuf-accounting-local-review.json; host extracted-function regression report: evidence/dmabuf-accounting-check.json.
